classes.meaning: Exact canonical bytes, field presence, algorithm and expected outcome are unchanged.
Wire representation may be regenerated without changing parsed meaning or expected outcome.
Optional capability is added and every older consumer remains conforming for the pre-existing profile.
Existing valid bytes, accepted objects or expected outcomes change. Coordinated migration and downgrade policy are mandatory.
Current behavior is frozen only to make a known defect explicit. It must be superseded by a new profile, never silently edited.
Security or robustness corpus that does not itself define protocol semantics.
Ownership, process or metadata change with no wire or expected-outcome change.
Public source-language or compile-time consumer contracts change while accepted JSON bytes, protocol wire semantics and expected verification outcomes remain unchanged.

A value is added to, or deprecated in, a registered vocabulary. No schema, closed vocabulary or rule changes; a consumer holding an earlier version of the vocabulary reports the value as unknown and remains conforming.
